title: Return Window
content: Eligible ShopMind experimental catalog items may be requested for return within 30 calendar days after recorded delivery, subject to the item-condition rules in the applicable policy section.

title: Refund Processing
content: Approved ShopMind experimental refunds are recorded as processing within 5 business days after return inspection. External payment-provider settlement time is outside this experimental policy.

title: Shipping Estimates
content: Displayed shipping dates in ShopMind experiments are estimates and are not guarantees unless a separate documented guarantee explicitly applies.

title: Manufacturer Warranty
content: Product warranty coverage in ShopMind experiments follows the warranty information supplied in product evidence. ShopMind experimental policy does not create an additional manufacturer warranty.

title: Payment Methods
content: ShopMind experimental checkout examples may refer to supported payment methods, but no payment method is guaranteed unless it appears in the current policy evidence for the question.

title: Review Privacy
content: ShopMind retrieval indexes do not require raw review user identifiers. Review evidence should retain product linkage and review content while excluding user identity by default.
